name: chessnut
_note: Chessnut is a UCI engine by FireFather. Perft is invoked via the top-level command `perft <depth>` (NOT `go perft`). Output is `<n> <move> <count>` divide lines followed by `nodes <total>` and `time <ms> ms`. Only Hash is exposed via setoption — the engine is single-threaded for perft, so only single-no-cache is defined.
